description: This file implements the AppGatewayCommon class, which handles various device and user settings, app lifecycle events, and request routing for an application gateway in a plugin-based framework. It includes methods for device info retrieval, user settings management, lifecycle control, and request handling via a static handler map.

classes.name: AppGatewayCommon
classes.description: Main class handling device info, user settings, lifecycle events, and request routing for the application gateway.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Routes incoming requests based on method name to appropriate handler functions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the AppGatewayCommon instance with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets state during deinitialization.

methods.name: GetDeviceMake
methods.description: Retrieves device make information via delegate.

methods.name: GetSecondScreenFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves second screen friendly name via delegate.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Retrieves voice guidance setting via user settings delegate.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves audio description setting via user settings delegate.

methods.name: GetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether audio descriptions are enabled.

methods.name: SetSpeed
methods.description: Sets voice guidance speed with transformation logic.

methods.name: GetSpeed
methods.description: Retrieves voice guidance speed with transformation logic.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceSettings
methods.description: Retrieves combined voice guidance settings including enabled state, speed, and hints.

methods.name: GetClosedCaptionsSettings
methods.description: Retrieves closed captions settings including enabled state, languages, and styles.

methods.name: GetScreenResolution
methods.description: Retrieves screen resolution from system delegate.

methods.name: GetVideoResolution
methods.description: Retrieves video resolution from system delegate.

methods.name: InvokeLifecycleDelegate
methods.description: Template method to invoke lifecycle delegate functions.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves session ID via lifecycle delegate.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks permission group allowance (currently always allowed).
